visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a minimalist, high-end coffee shop, a barista in a white lab-style coat is meticulously preparing a pour-over. He holds a black kettle, pouring water in circular motions over coffee grounds in a glass dripper placed on a digital scale. The background features blurred figures of other customers and a modern, black counter setup with soft, overhead lighting. (2) Transition to a different barista wearing a white shirt and a black bowtie, carefully measuring coffee beans into a small metal cup. In the background, floor-to-ceiling wooden shelves are packed with hundreds of small white and brown packages of coffee beans, creating a geometric pattern. The camera moves with a slight handheld jitter, adding a natural feel. (3) A white menu card titled KOFFEE COURSE is held by a hand, listing three options with prices. Another hand displays a more detailed SIGNATURE menu. The lighting is warm and bright, highlighting the texture of the paper and the wooden table surface. The scene is clean and focused on the tactile elements of the experience. (4) A woman with dark hair pulled back in a ponytail, wearing a beige and black horizontal striped sweater, is shown sitting at the bar. She takes a bite of a small yellow citrus-like dessert using a toothpick, followed by a sip of a creamy, tan-colored beverage from a stemmed wine glass. Her facial expressions shift from curiosity to surprise and then to a happy, satisfied smile, punctuated by heart-eyed emojis on the screen. (5) Close-up shots show the Mocktail preparation: a creamy liquid is poured into a glass beaker containing a dark liquid. This mixture is then filtered through a plastic dripper with a white paper filter, with yellow-brown liquid slowly dripping into a mug below. The woman is seen drinking from a black mug, looking contemplative as she tastes the complex flavors. (6) The final phase shows a tall glass filled with a bubbly, golden-amber liquid and large ice cubes, topped with a layer of foam. The woman takes a sip of this Caramel MakKiato coffee cocktail and gives a subtle nod of approval. The scene cuts to the exterior of the building, a grey corrugated metal structure with a stone sign reading KOFFEE MAMEYA -Kakeru-, and a smartphone displaying a booking interface.

The background music maintains its tempo, driving the video's pacing. The narration concludes with information about reservations and location, while the acoustic guitar track swells slightly in intensity for a final flourish before a quick fade-out.
